svg.title: Figure 19 · A scheduled-event variance budget
svg.desc: Toy ATM variance w(T) = 0.04 T + 0.01 once T reaches 0.25 years. This is a discrete jump in a variance budget, not an exact option-pricing formula for an arbitrary jump distribution; the smooth Dupire formula cannot be applied at the jump.
